parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.778 suggests structural overlap, `multipleStopCallsAreIdempotent` and `playAfterStopWorks` are distinct behavioral assertions — one verifies idempotency of repeated stop calls and the other verifies that playback resumes correctly after a stop — so their structural resemblance is incidental to the test-fixture pattern. Merging or extracting test methods risks obscuring test intent and coupling unrelated behavioral contracts. The restraint rule for `is_test` records dominates here.
